name: aiPHeed provincial food-insecurity risk forecast (E56 LightGBM, experimental)
status: EXPERIMENTAL - development evidence, not independently validated; enabled only with AIPHEED_LEAD2_MODEL=e56
modelVersion: E56-TUNED: LightGBM price-signal classifier (structural CPI offset, intercept-free boosting; configuration chosen per origin by nested chronological validation) x I7 regional hunger component (E56 protocol sha 81e4923d7b5d2a66)

dataFreshness.note: Target data (SWS hunger and PSA CPI) were known through 2026-Q2 at the issue date; predictors run through 2026-Q3 (CPI through 2026-08). The 2026-Q3 SWS round and September 2026 CPI were released after the issue date and are not used. Direct food-insecurity surveys (FNRI FIES, PSA subsistence) end in 2023.

information.rule: only data published before the origin

indicator.name: Food-Insecurity Risk Probability (experimental)
indicator.definition: Probability that the province is at HIGH food-insecurity risk in the target quarter (target T43, Chapter I section 1.7): the regional SWS hunger rate (Balance Luzon) above 11.3% AND provincial food-price pressure (PSA food inflation, or food minus headline inflation, above the province's 2021-2022 60th percentile). Estimated by the E56 LightGBM model (two quarters ahead of the latest predictor quarter). It is a risk classification, not a measured prevalence of household food insecurity; hunger is measured only for the whole region.
indicator.horizon: two-quarter-ahead forecast issued 2026-10-01 from predictors through 2026-Q3 (latest observed food-insecurity risk data: 2026-Q2)
indicator.source: SWS hunger (Balance Luzon); PSA provincial food and headline CPI and wholesale rice; typhoon tracks and ENSO; PSA production; PSA LFS (national); BSP remittances and ECB USD/PHP (national); news; official rice-policy orders; PSA 2021 SAE poverty (candidate input)
indicator.caveat: Risk classification from regional hunger and provincial food prices, not a measured provincial prevalence. Development evidence only (E56). Indicative decision support only. Target data (SWS hunger and PSA CPI) were known through 2026-Q2 at the issue date; predictors run through 2026-Q3 (CPI through 2026-08). The 2026-Q3 SWS round and September 2026 CPI were released after the issue date and are not used. Direct food-insecurity surveys (FNRI FIES, PSA subsistence) end in 2023.

scoreTypes.food_insecurity_risk_probability: Probability that the province is at HIGH food-insecurity risk in the target quarter (target T43, Chapter I section 1.7): the regional SWS hunger rate (Balance Luzon) above 11.3% AND provincial food-price pressure (PSA food inflation, or food minus headline inflation, above the province's 2021-2022 60th percentile). Estimated by the E56 LightGBM model (two quarters ahead of the latest predictor quarter). It is a risk classification, not a measured prevalence of household food insecurity; hunger is measured only for the whole region.

attributionMethod: Exact TreeSHAP (LightGBM pred_contrib) of the food-price part of the forecast, in log-odds, grouped by trigger; Market / Prices also carries the projected food inflation built from PSA CPI (the model's starting point) and the rice-policy orders; each group includes its own news share; total news volume and poverty (when selected) are reported outside the five bars. A group whose inputs were all missing at the issue date is shown as insufficient data. The regional hunger part is shown separately. Model attributions, not causes.

operationalRules.band: Low if P < 0.33; Watch if 0.33 <= P < 0.67; High if P >= 0.67
operationalRules.alert: Alert candidate when the band is High; staged for administrator confirmation.
operationalRules.municipal: No municipal probability; LGU rankings are relative prioritization weighted by PSA 2021 poverty and 2024 population density.
operationalRules.rollback: unset AIPHEED_LEAD2_MODEL (or set e38) to return to the production default E38
